note: Single-byte WHATWG sets, ISO 8859-1, 22 EBCDIC code pages (IBM 037 to 1149), UTF-8 and UTF-16. The multi-byte legacy sets (Shift_JIS, GBK, Big5, EUC-JP/KR, ISO-2022-JP) are decode only, because the host has no encoder for them; UTF-7 and UTF-32 are not offered.
All WHATWG encodings of the browser (single-byte, CJK, UTF-16), ISO 8859-1 and 22 EBCDIC code pages; strict or lenient. UTF-7 and UTF-32 are not offered.

Returns a list of { encoding, text } records for every encoding in which the bytes decode strictly; only the first sample bytes (default 4096, at most 16384) are decoded. Brute-forcing the encode direction is not offered.
